== Biography ==
William Davies, a farmer, is named as father of Janet (indexed as Janet Glasgow), baptised at Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, on 17 July 1748; her mother is indexed as Janet Kerr.<ref name="fmp3587035">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3587035&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929, transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/3587035], OPR 596/1. Index transcript inspected; original register not inspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Identity hold, 5 November 2026: the index gives the father's surname as Davies although the child is indexed as Glasgow; either surname may be an indexing error. Held as a separate record-defined person until the register is read. Not equated with any Glasgow man at Kilbirnie.

Next research: inspect OPR 596/1 for the child's and the father's surnames, residence and witnesses.

Identity resolution, 16 November 2026: no existing catalogue profile matched this record. The record defines a distinct documentary person; later life and any relationships beyond those stated in the record remain unresolved. The sourced draft is creation-ready with those limits.

<!-- record-fa3-william-glasgow-richmond-yorks: William Glasgow -->
[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
William Glasgow is named as the father of Mary Glasgow, christened on 17 Apr 1794 at Richmond near Leyburn, Yorkshire.<ref name="anc193434698">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/193434698 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975, Mary Glasgow, 17 Apr 1794, Richmond Near Leyburn, York]. Index entry; original uninspected.</ref> A father written Willm. Glasgow is named at the christening of a second Mary Glasgow on 4 Nov 1801 at the same place, probably the same man after the first Mary's death; this is an inference from the shared name and place.<ref name="anc193434524">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/193434524 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975, Mary Glasgow, 4 Nov 1801, Richmond Near Leyburn, York]. Index entry; original uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Created 5 Nov 2026 (worker FA3) as the documentary father of the two Richmond christenings. The earlier matcher suggested Glasgow-3324 (William Glasgow of Larne, County Antrim, 1763-1816) as a possible identity; the place does not fit and that William's children (Elizabeth, Jane Shutter, Mary) are an Antrim family, so he is not adopted. William Glasgow, father of John christened at Richmond on 7 Sep 1795 (Ancestry 156478595), is probably the same man; that entry is held on a separate draft (record-ancestry-glasgow-24953d4cdb62) and was not merged here.

Next research: inspect the Richmond (St Mary / Holy Trinity) registers for the mother, residence and occupation; look for a marriage of William Glasgow about 1790-93 in the North Riding.
